title: Dialogue: Mixed Idioms and Expressions (poziom rejonowy/wojewodzki)

tasks.instruction: Uzupelnij ponizsze dialogi (1.1-1.6), wybierajac brakujace wyrazenie A, B lub C.

items.stem:
X: Losing that place on the team turned out well in the end.
Y: Yes, it was a blessing in ______.

X: Did you hear that Ania won the scholarship?
Y: She must be over the ______.

X: These instructions look really complicated.
Y: Don't worry, you'll soon get the ______ of it.

X: Should I apply even though I probably won't get in?
Y: Definitely - nothing ______, nothing gained.

X: We've been working on this for hours and got nowhere.
Y: I think we should call it a ______.

X: Are you nervous about telling him you broke it?
Y: A bit, but I'll just have to ______ the bullet.
